Positioned after the fully drawn tension of 79:1 and before free coursing in 79:3, this branch acts as the release point. I infer that a restraint held the prior force and that its loosening converts tension into motion. The ayah reads as a decisive unfastening, not simply energetic activity.

The line can thus describe agents or entities becoming mobile as they are drawn from their prior place.
